verdict.rationale: NotebookLM offers a 'Debate' audio-overview format explicitly for 'exploring multiple perspectives' and lets analysts select specific sources to query and view inline citations back to exact source text, which supports cross-checking claims across sources. However, there is no documented feature that explicitly surfaces or flags where sources agree/disagree within the standard chat answer (e.g., no contradiction-detection or side-by-side comparison view), so the core of the story is only partially covered. Missing for 10: an explicit text-based agreement/disagreement synthesis in chat answers, and any hands-on/independent evidence confirming this behavior works well in practice.
